title: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine, garlicky homemade croutons and seared chicken tossed in a quick lemony Caesar dressing with plenty of Parmesan.

image.alt: A bowl of romaine with sliced chicken, croutons and shaved Parmesan

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Toss the bread with 2 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of the salt on the baking sheet and bake until golden and crisp, {time 10-12 min}.

Season the chicken with the rest of the salt. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and cook until golden and it reads {temp 165F internal}, {time 5-6 min} per side. Rest for {time 5 min}, then slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire, mustard, half the Parmesan and the pepper until smooth. Thin with a splash of water if it’s too thick to toss.
Toss the romaine with the dressing in a large bowl until every leaf is coated. Top with the chicken, croutons and the rest of the Parmesan.

notes: Traditional Caesar dressing uses anchovies; mash 2 fillets into the dressing if you like that savory depth.
Croutons keep in an airtight container for 3 days.
